name: @citolab/pci-kitchen-dosing
description: recipe scaling and dosing (recept omrekenen en doseren) for kitchen and cleaning in praktijkonderwijs: compute the amounts of a recipe for more or fewer persons and measure them with a kitchen scale, a measuring jug, spoons and pieces, or choose a cleaning product, compute its dose for a bucket of water and pour it with a dosing cup; all drawn in SVG

scripts.prepack: npm run prod && npm run package-tao
